description:
Kang Si-Young, a high school graduate who knows how to drive a tractor but doesn't know a thing about math. Due to her parents' sudden wealth from a crop called 'starfruit', she starts preparing for college late, and her life is 'ruined' when she meets Lee Shin-Hwa, a professional tutor from Seoul National University. The sweet story of a prestigious university student and a third-year repeater unfolds in the countryside in the middle of summer. 

(Source: Comico Korea, translated) 

*Note: Bomtoon has both R15 and R19 version in the same page, if your account is verified it will show the R19 version but if not you will view the R15 one.*
